title: HTMX + Prism
content:
When combined with Prism, Photon becomes a powerful engine for HDA (Hypermedia Driven Applications). HTMX allows you to update specific parts of the DOM with server-rendered HTML fragments.

Pattern: Fragment Rendering

In Prism, you can define sections or partials that can be rendered independently of the main layout when an HTMX request is detected.

app.get('/search', async (c) => {
  const query = c.req.query('q')
  const view = c.get('view')
  
  // Detection via headers
  if (c.req.header('HX-Request')) {
    return c.html(view.render('partials/search-results', { query }))
  }
  
  return c.html(view.render('search-page', { query }))
})

In-Place Updates

<!-- Home View -->
<div id="counter">0</div>
<button hx-post="/increment" 
        hx-target="#counter">
  Increment
</button>

Ultra-Fast Fragments

Because Prism templates are pre-compiled AOT, rendering a small HTML fragment for an HTMX request typically takes less than 0.2ms, making the UI feel native.
